<notes>
kept -> base harness -> all 3 base rollouts delivered identical correct answer (358,803) with no divergence, no repeated failures, no visible fragility in trajectories. All 6 candidates show "(no change)" in harness.diff; their single rollouts reinforce the base behavior. Library precedents (holdout-numeric-002, holdout-numeric-005) apply only to tasks WITH divergence or failure in base runs (002: base1 wrong, base2/3 right; 005: base2 hallucinated 434, base3 fallback to 254). This task exhibits neither divergence nor failure. The LLM performs step-by-step arithmetic correctly and consistently across all three runs without code execution. No moment in any trajectory shows where adding code extraction, instruction, or other edits would have changed the outcome. All previous aggregators (inv1-dom3) correctly concluded KEEP_BASE with identical reasoning. The cost of adding mechanism without demonstrated problem violates the rule: "Do not fix what the runs already got right."
</notes>
